wages.text: As a City Council member, he passed living-wage laws for app-based drivers and protections for fast-food, retail, and freelance workers.
wages.quote: He passed the first laws in the country to guarantee a living wage for Uber and Lyft drivers and deliveristas

debt.text: His campaign says he protected city retirees from being moved to Medicare Advantage plans and will fight attacks on Social Security.
debt.quote: And he protected NYC retirees from being forced into inferior Medicare Advantage plans.

schools.text: He led a campaign that secured air conditioning in every New York City public-school classroom.
schools.quote: He led the campaign that secured air-conditioning in every NYC public school classroom

abortion.text: He supports codifying abortion rights and repealing the Hyde Amendment.
abortion.quote: In Congress, I will fight to codify a right to an abortion
